what: Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport (ZSSS / SHA) airport geometry for SHA Live 3D: runways (OSM centrelines; ends measured on Sentinel-2 and Umbra SAR; dimensions, displaced thresholds, declared distances, THR elevations and lighting as short facts from an unofficial AIP mirror, in one aip_facts block per runway with its own notice), taxiways and taxilanes (OSM, re-fitted to Sentinel-2 where measured), holding positions, aprons, helipads, derived surface polygons, buildings with heights (OSM / AIP obstacle / rule), the control tower, inferred glide-path antennas, the aerodrome boundary, and context (Hongqiao transport hub, roads, rail, canals, buildings) inside the detailed extent. No stands (task A2).

frame.origin_def: OD0: midpoint (arithmetic mean of lat/lon) of the end nodes of OSM way 16714125 (RWY 18L/36R): node 3336195147 31.2131135 N 121.3354641 E (v3) and node 13556389849 31.1825842 N 121.3371157 E (v1); = centre of RWY 18L/36R, the AIP ARP definition. The AIP ARP itself is printed as N31 11.8 E121 20.1 (0.1 min, AIP mirror)
frame.axes: x = east (m), z = south (m), y = up (m); world unit vector of true heading h = (sin h, -cos h)
frame.projection: exact local tangent plane (ENU) on the WGS 84 ellipsoid at the origin, h = 0: lat/lon -> ECEF -> east/north; flat world (y is height above the ground point). Plane vs geodesic distance < 0.5 mm within 5 km; curvature drop not drawn (1.96 m at 5 km)
frame.datum_note: all inputs are WGS 84 (OSM, Sentinel-2, Umbra, ADS-B); no shift applied. CGCS2000 differs for a fixed point by the plate motion since 2000.0 (0.78 m, ITRF2014:EURA model) [inf], not modelled
frame.y: AIP height datum (metres, AIP mirror AD 2.2 / 2.12; datum not stated; Shanghai Wusong height inferred: H_Wusong = H_1985 + 1.680 m)
frame.ground_y_note: nominal flat ground for code without terrain = mean of the 8 AIP (mirror) THR/DTHR elevations, 2.49 m [inf]; use the runway profiles on runways
frame.k_dem_note: y = H_EGM2008 (Copernicus GLO-30 DEM) + k_dem; measured at the 8 AIP runway points (all on WorldDEM airport-edited planes) [obs]; DEM LE90 1.92 m, so +-2 m

geoid_egm2008.note: N(x,z) = n0 + dn_dx*x + dn_dz*z (plane fit to NGA us_nga_egm08_25.tif, +-4 mm within 4 km); h_WGS84 = y - k_dem + N; N over the detailed extent 11.16-11.35 m

frame.qnh_note: altitude on QNH ~ y; ADS-B alt_baro needs QNH (frame.y_from_pressure_alt, ISA) [inf]
frame.ring_convention: polygon rings are lists of [x, z]; open (first vertex not repeated)
